args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback verified as rolled out in all regions. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before re-attempting that release.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy, with an 18% error rate. The deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back:** checkout-api was rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback is verified as rolled out in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident:** Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer. The incident summary describes the failure, the rollback, and a follow-up to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 before re-attempting the release.
